patch.role: Whitespace-only cleanup: strips spaces/tabs for single-line input.
Newline-tolerant cleanup: strips spaces/newlines when no tab is present.

inputs.mask_padded: import line padded by spaces: either cleanup path suffices
inputs.expose_tab_newline: line with both a tab and a newline: neither guard fires

rationale: format_simplified() trims the whole line. The patch offers two alternative cleanups with different character coverage: on a space-padded line each one alone reproduces A (two singleton minimal sets), while a line that contains both a tab and a newline is outside both guards and exposes the gap.
